name: MUS
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.
rootCause: deposit refunds a first-deposit bonus and also credits it as withdrawable allocation, so a single deposit-withdraw from a fresh address returns more ETH than deposited. Lost: ~0.400168 ETH per deposit-withdraw cycle (exactly reproduced) on Ethereum; the MUS pool's standing 5.335 ETH was drained to 0 across the attack block, reported campaign total ~$36.9k across many fresh addresses
